description: This Java source file defines a final class 'DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' which is a builder for creating responses and events related to deleting features in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested classes for response and event factories, and methods for constructing specific response types and events.
